task.description:
Hard gate: validate the design artefact at src/design/WF02-qry05-sbx01-03-20260818.md.

Check against requirements QRY-05, SBX-01, SBX-02, SBX-03 from docs/requirements.yaml.

Validation criteria:
1. Every acceptance criterion from all 4 requirements is addressed in the design
2. The design contains NO implementation code (only interfaces, types, signatures, DDL)
3. The design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity
4. All new DB tables, migrations, and Zig module paths are named
5. All error codes referenced in requirements are covered
6. Security invariants satisfied (tenant isolation, no cross-tenant reads)

Return PASS if all criteria met, FAIL with specific gaps if not.
